messages:
Marcos (eng-platform): Heads up — we need a quick decision on the tenant-level policy editor for RBAC. Two main asks from sales/enterprise: (1) express per-route allowlists (e.g. embeddings-only for billing-team) and (2) clear override semantics when project/tenant/global rules conflict. Thoughts?
Lina (product): Reuse the scope-profiles concept? don't want to ship a totally separate UX. But enterprise admins asked for an explicit policy view.
Rahul (eng): Reuse is fine but we need bulk operations: CSV import/export, bulk bind/unbind, and an API. Also need a simulation API so orgs can test rules before applying.
Nadia (design): I sketched an inheritance tree view: Account > Tenant > Project > Route. Show effective decision with source badge (e.g., "inherited from Tenant"). Display compact rows with expand for JSON.
Marcos (eng-platform): Edge cases: temporary elevations (sudo/expired binds), service accounts with auto-expire, scoping by tags (region:eu), and explicit denies. How do we surface conflicts so admins can resolve?
Ethan (eng-infra): Proposed precedence: explicit deny > explicit allow > inherited allow. Backend can expose precedence in the API. Also we need efficient prefix matching for routes — decide prefix vs glob. Implementation note: cache invalidation on policy change is critical for latency.
Rahul (eng): For simulation: UI can have a "simulate as" input (principal + route + context) and backend returns matched rules + result. This helps admins debug. Example response shape we want: matched rule ids + source + effect.
Ethan (eng-infra): Pseudo-config we can support today:
```json
{
  "principal": "group:billing-team",
  "resource": "route:/v1/embeddings/*",
  "effect": "allow",
  "conditions": {"region": "eu"},
  "expires_at": "2026-04-10T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Marcos (eng-platform): Nice. For the console: show expiry inline and a small timer for temp binds. Also an audit link to event logs for every policy row.
Nadia (design): Wireframe idea: rule row with color pill (green allow, red deny, yellow conditional), brief summary, and expand to show full JSON and "why this matched" from simulation. Add a "dry-run" toggle on rollout so new tenant rules can be applied in "report only" for 24h.
Lina (product): Admins asked for infra-as-code: export effective policies as policy files and a CSV of effective permissions per-principal. Also request: bulk migrate roles when tenant re-orgs.
Rahul (eng): Need to ensure API supports role composition (composite roles) and role versioning for rollbacks. Also add endpoint to list effective permissions for a principal across projects.
Ethan (eng-infra): Wildcard/prefix decision: prefer prefix matching for clarity (fast to evaluate). If customers want globs later, we can add it but default to prefix. Caching: tag caches by policy-version; increment version on change so we can cheap invalidate.
Marcos (eng-platform): For rollout UX: default new tenant policies to "dry-run for 24h" and show a banner with conflicts detected and impact estimate (how many principals/routes changed). Also show an "enforce now" button.
Rahul (eng): We should expose a CLI snippet in the UI for each policy so infra teams can copy-paste into their infra code.
Nadia (design): I'll produce high-fidelity comps for: policy list, rule detail panel, simulation panel, and rollout modal. Will include the dry-run banner and conflict resolution flow.
Marcos (eng-platform): Great. Action items: Nadia to deliver comps by EOW, Rahul + Ethan to draft API + simulation contract, Lina to collect enterprise success stories/requirements. I'll assemble a small spec for the eng squad.
audit-bot: Policy change created by Marcos (eng-platform) at 1719204600 — dry-run mode enabled (automated entry).
Marcos (eng-platform): Thanks all — planning sync Tues to lock API shape and UX interactions.
